sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Covert Movement is a Practical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Covert movement makes your steps quieter and reduces the sound radius when moving slow.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Reduces noise level of footsteps on common surfaces (1.2% per level → -60% at Elite Level)
- Reduces noise level of footsteps on uncommon surfaces (0.6% per level → -30% at Elite Level)
- Increases covert movement speed (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
- Reduces noise level of weapons and equipment (1.2% per level → -60% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Covert movement becomes equally quiet on all surfaces (-60% total)

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Moving with less than 25% speed, the speaker icon needs to have no bar. The XP gain is calculated based on distance covered when the player stops moving.

- Completing the quest Profitable Venture
- Completing the quest Safety Guarantee
- Completing the quest Connections Up North
